scope: Portal navigation and match setup; game implementations unchanged

single_player: Choose Play vs robot and enter a guest nickname
Play board moves and observe computer replies
Observe the result and Play again action
multiplayer: Host chooses Play with a friend and enters a guest nickname
Waiting screen displays a complete invitation URL
Open that URL in an independent browser context
Accept the named invitation and enter a different guest nickname
Play alternating moves to a result visible in both sessions
Request a rematch and observe waiting and opponent-consent prompts
references.notes: Rematch request and consent UI were inspected; a second rematch was not completed before the site's leave countdown.

single_player: Open Solitaire and play a legal tableau move and stock draw
Start a new game after confirming abandonment
private_table: Open Hearts multiplayer and create a private table
Observe a room code, selectable invitation URL and waiting-for-players message
Leave the private table after inspection
references.limitation: Separate browser contexts received identical server-issued multiplayer identities, so a two-session match was verified on Papergames.io instead.

references.inspection: Public catalog, Solo filter and tutorial entry

adaptations: Explicit friends, computer and device play choices
A direct private-table creation action with public matches kept separate
Optional settings collapsed, with selected stakes and clocks visible in their summary
Immediate solo starts from catalog, recent, popular and detail entries
